plugins.name: sweeps
plugins.description: Two paired repository sweeps with opposite calibrations: truing finds what a repo says that is not so, parsimony proposes what should stop existing.

plugins.name: noun
plugins.description: The Noun Project icon API, as one skill: sign a request with the keys in the environment, search and fetch icons, download them in a colour, and mind the quota and the attribution.

plugins.name: rung
plugins.description: A structured discussion that leaves one person understanding something: an interview and expert pillar, followed by reader-led parts and short clarifications in an anchored, checked voice. After Part 0, one provisional next part can be prepared while the reader reads, then reconciled with their actual reply.
